_about: Before/after of the nine "Why this food?" lines changed on 1 Nov 2026 (owner-approved direction). Phase assignments unchanged.

rewrites.shortBefore: Mussels are a rich source of iron (about 32% of the daily value per serving) and protein, so we highlight them during menstruation.
rewrites.shortAfter: Mussels are a rich source of iron (about 32% of the daily value in 3 ounces cooked) and protein.
rewrites.detailBefore: Mussels are a rich source of iron (about 32% of the daily value per serving) and protein, so we highlight them during menstruation.
rewrites.detailAfter: Mussels are a rich source of iron (about 32% of the daily value in 3 ounces cooked) and protein.

rewrites.shortBefore: Oysters are a rich source of iron (about 37% of the daily value per serving), which is why we highlight them during menstruation.
rewrites.shortAfter: Oysters are a rich source of iron (about 21% of the daily value in six medium oysters).
rewrites.detailBefore: Oysters are a rich source of iron (about 37% of the daily value per serving), which is why we highlight them during menstruation.
rewrites.detailAfter: Oysters are a rich source of iron (about 21% of the daily value in six medium oysters).

rewrites.shortBefore: Sardines add iron (about 11% of the daily value per serving) and are easy to put on toast or in pasta.
rewrites.shortAfter: Sardines add iron (about 15% of the daily value in one 3.75-ounce can, drained) and are easy to put on toast or in pasta.
rewrites.detailBefore: Sardines add iron (about 11% of the daily value per serving) and are easy to put on toast or in pasta.
rewrites.detailAfter: Sardines add iron (about 15% of the daily value in one 3.75-ounce can, drained) and are easy to put on toast or in pasta.

rewrites.shortBefore: Lentils provide plant-based iron, protein and fibre, which is why we highlight them during menstruation.
rewrites.shortAfter: Lentils provide plant-based iron (about 18% of the daily value in half a cup cooked), protein and fibre.
rewrites.detailBefore: Lentils provide plant-based iron, protein and fibre, which is why we highlight them during menstruation.
rewrites.detailAfter: Lentils provide plant-based iron (about 18% of the daily value in half a cup cooked), protein and fibre.

rewrites.shortBefore: Quinoa adds some plant-based iron (about 12% of the daily value per serving) and is lovely in warm bowls.
rewrites.shortAfter: Quinoa adds some plant-based iron (about 8% of the daily value in half a cup cooked) and is lovely in warm bowls.

rewrites.detailAfter: Quinoa adds some plant-based iron (about 8% of the daily value in half a cup cooked) and is lovely in warm bowls.

rewrites.shortBefore: Cooked spinach provides iron (about 18% of the daily value per serving) along with folate, which is why we highlight it during menstruation.
rewrites.shortAfter: Cooked spinach provides iron (about 18% of the daily value in half a cup cooked) along with folate.
rewrites.detailBefore: Cooked spinach provides iron (about 18% of the daily value per serving) along with folate, which is why we highlight it during menstruation.
rewrites.detailAfter: Cooked spinach provides iron (about 18% of the daily value in half a cup cooked) along with folate.

rewrites.shortBefore: Anchovies are a concentrated source of iron (about 22% of the daily value per serving) and protein.
rewrites.shortAfter: Anchovies are a concentrated source of iron, but a typical serving is small (five anchovies give about 5% of the daily value).
rewrites.detailBefore: Anchovies are a concentrated source of iron (about 22% of the daily value per serving) and protein. A few go a long way in pasta, salads or on toast.
rewrites.detailAfter: Anchovies are a concentrated source of iron, but a typical serving is small (five anchovies give about 5% of the daily value). A few go a long way in pasta, salads or on toast.
